title: clients.yml
description: Per-client configuration for the GS1 Digital Link Orchestrator. Derived from PROJECT_HANDOVER.md §10.1 and IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md §2.4. Secrets are never stored here; *_env keys name environment variables that hold them.

version.description: Config schema version. Locked at 1 for v0.1.0.

defaults.description: Settings inherited by every client unless overridden per client.

clients.description: Map of client_id to that client's configuration.

environment.description: Which GS1 NL environment to target.

api_version.description: Digital Link API version. Locked at v2 for v0.1.0.

identification_key_type.description: GS1 identifier type. Always Gtin for v0.1.0 scope.

digital_link_url_pattern.description: Template for the canonical Digital Link URI; {gtin14} is substituted.

default_media_type.description: mediaType applied to links that don't specify one (e.g. text/html).

batch_size.description: Entries per request to the bulk upsert endpoint.

resolver_domain_name.description: Only meaningful when use_gs1_resolver is false.

account_number_test.description: accountNumber for the test/sandbox environment — taken from the minted token's accountNumber claim. Differs from production.

account_number_production.description: accountNumber for the production environment. Verify against MyGS1.

client_id_env_test.description: Name of the env var holding the test/sandbox OAuth2 client id.

client_secret_env_test.description: Name of the env var holding the test/sandbox OAuth2 client secret.

client_id_env_production.description: Name of the env var holding the production OAuth2 client id.

client_secret_env_production.description: Name of the env var holding the production OAuth2 client secret.

wpml_helper_path.description: Path to the site-side WPML helper route (multilingual_plugin: wpml only). WPML exposes no core REST route for language assignment or translation linking; the namespace is per-site.

site_url.description: Base URL of the client's WordPress site.

username.description: Automation user (Editor role) for REST calls.

app_password_env.description: Name of the env var holding the WordPress application password.

wpml_helper_path.description: Path to the site-side WPML helper route (multilingual_plugin: wpml only). WPML exposes no core REST route for language assignment or translation linking; the namespace is per-site.

taxonomies.description: Map of WordPress taxonomy slug to how its terms are sourced.

map_from_column.description: ProductRecord field / export column that supplies the term.

acf_map.description: Map of ACF field name to the ProductRecord field feeding it, for themes that render from ACF rather than post_content (e.g. Oxygen). Reach into extras with 'extras.{name}'. Omit for clients that render from the body template.

slug_pattern.description: Slug template, e.g. 'p-{gtin}'. Immutable once printed on packaging.

target_url_pattern.description: Template for the page URL the resolver points at.

format.description: Export layout. 'flat' = single-sheet MyGS1 article list; 'gdsn' = multi-sheet GS1 Data Source / GDSN datapool export.

path.description: Path to the client's GS1 Data Source / MyGS1 Excel/CSV export.

column_map.description: Flat format: mapping between export columns and ProductRecord field paths (a map of string to string).

extras_columns.description: Flat format: export columns carried through verbatim into ProductRecord.extras.

market_priority.description: GDSN format: TargetMarketCountryCodes in the order to consult them, e.g. ["528", "056", "276", "442"]. The first market with a non-blank value wins, per product/field/language; the same order picks scalars. The site's languages come from wordpress.languages.

gdsn_map.description: GDSN format: mapping of ProductRecord field name to the GDSN attribute source.

gdsn_extras.description: GDSN format: named pass-through attributes carried into ProductRecord.extras.

attribute.description: GDSN attribute number (e.g. '3297') or a path segment name (e.g. 'GpcCategoryCode').

localised.description: Whether the attribute is a per-language LanguageCode/Value group.

multivalue.description: For an attribute that repeats across [n] slots (e.g. TradeItemFeatureBenefit[n], or Material[0..2]), read every slot instead of only the first; blank slots are skipped. A localised attribute joins its slots with a newline (the generator splits attr 1067 back into ranked USPs on it); a language-agnostic one joins with ', ', because its value renders verbatim on the page.

with_unit.description: Whether to append the paired MeasurementUnitCode to the value.

max_length.description: Longest this value is expected to be, in characters. A longer value is reported to source_issues.json and kept verbatim — never truncated. Omit for no expectation.

strip_prefix.description: Literal prefix removed from the resolved value when present (e.g. 'Democlient ' where the feed repeats the brand in the product name). Matched exactly; a value that only resembles the prefix is reported as a likely source-data misspelling and left unchanged, never repaired.

primary_file.description: Whether to resolve the primary referenced-file URI (for image_url).

report_issues.description: Whether this field's cross-market findings — value_blank (absent from every market) and value_inconsistent_across_markets (markets disagree) — reach source_issues.json. Default true. Set false for a field the tool parses but does not publish directly (e.g. a generator input), whose findings are deferred. Does not affect value_too_long / brand_prefix_mismatch.

required.description: Whether a product missing this value may never publish (E23). A localised field must be non-blank in every configured language; the hold is per product, not per language, so a SKU is never half-published. Mutually exclusive with required_group.

required_group.description: Name of an either-or group: the product satisfies it when at least one member carries a value. For alternatives where neither field is individually mandatory but one must be present (e.g. marketing copy from attr 1083 or 1067). Mutually exclusive with required.

in_matrix.description: Whether this field gets a column in the data-quality report's coverage matrix. Default true. Set false for a value the pipeline carries but nothing consumes — a column present for every product that feeds nothing is noise in a table whose job is to show gaps. Does not stop the field being parsed.

translate.description: Whether the generator may fill this value in a language the feed lacks, by translating it from a language the feed has. Default false — opt in per field, because every filled value costs producer tokens and puts more LLM-written text on the page. A field blank in every language is never filled and stays a source finding. Each filled value is reported so it can be put back into MyGS1.

override_dir.description: Directory holding this client's template overrides.

files.description: Map of language code to template filename.

default.description: Whether this is the default link type. Applied to the default language's link only, however many languages the record carries.

title_pattern.description: Template for the link title, e.g. '{product_name}'.

on_change.description: Behaviour when a re-run detects changed rows (default: prompt).

on_missing_field.description: Behaviour when a required per-language field is missing (default: prompt).

processList.description: Operator-maintained list of exactly which GTINs a run may touch. Every GTIN in the file is processed; no cell values are interpreted. The operator prepares it by deleting rows that should not run.

target_url_column.description: Optional column holding the address of a page this tool did not make (e.g. 'Link naar site'). A links run points the product's GS1 record at it. Blank cells change nothing.

categories.description: Phase 7.5: GPC brick -> client category-term mapping. Client-owned, signed-off data. Term-membership of map/override values is enforced by the loader, not this schema.

terms.description: The closed set of allowed category terms.

brick_category_map.description: Map of GPC brick code to a category term.

overrides.description: Per-GTIN category term, overriding the brick map for bricks that span categories.

on_unmapped.description: What to do with a brick that maps to no term. Fixed at 'warn': leave unset, never guess.

require_terms_exist.description: Whether a resolved term must already exist as a WordPress taxonomy term (vs auto-create). Recorded here; enforced at the future term-assignment step.

generator.description: Content-generator (LLM copy) settings. The API backend is opt-in via enabled; api_key_env names the env var holding the key, never the key. prompt_version selects the frozen voice template prompts/{client}/generation.{prompt_version}.md and is part of the input fingerprint.

enabled.description: Whether the API backend (run_generate --backend api) may run for this client. Defaults false; the in-session producer needs no key.

model.description: Anthropic model id, e.g. claude-sonnet-5. Prefer a pinned snapshot for production.

prompt_version.description: Voice/prompt template version; selects prompts/{client}/generation.{prompt_version}.md and is part of the input fingerprint, so bumping it makes existing copy read as stale.

api_key_env.description: Name of the env var holding the Anthropic API key.

max_tokens.description: Max output tokens per generation call.

media.description: Phase 9.5 media: image convert/resize params, per-language video folders, the confirmed video mapping path, and the ACF field names media is written to (names in config, not code).

image_max_dim.description: Longest-edge cap in pixels for the uploaded hero image.

image_quality.description: JPEG quality (1-100) for the converted image.

header_image_field.description: ACF field name for the hero image.

regular_image_field.description: ACF field name for the main image (usually the same hero attachment).

video_file_field.description: ACF field name for the product video attachment.

image_write_shape.description: Whether the image ACF fields take a WP attachment id or a URL string. Confirm live before trusting (page-adapter §3 write-shape trap).

video_folders.description: Per-language folder of operator-supplied videos, e.g. {nl: path, fr: path}.

video_map_path.description: Path to the client-confirmed video name->GTIN mapping YAML.

video_transcode.description: Transcode source videos to H.264 MP4 via ffmpeg before upload (MPEG-1/2 will not play in-browser).

restrict_to_mapped_gtins.description: When true, run_plan/run_execute process only GTINs with a client-confirmed video in every language; every other GTIN is blocked.

publish_without_video.description: Only with restrict_to_mapped_gtins. When true, a GTIN with no confirmed video in some language publishes without one there and is listed as missing it; a GTIN confirmed to two files in one language is still held.

require_hero_image.description: When true, a GTIN whose source image_url is blank is held out of the plan (E22) — a hero image is treated as required. Off by default. A runtime image fetch failure still degrades gracefully (E7).

enabled.description: Whether this client is processed. Defaults to true when omitted.
